The execution failed because the Excel formulas for PERCENTILE.INC resulted in #NAME? errors during evaluation (as reported by the test suite's validation of the generated file). 

Specifically, cells H46:L47 (25th and 75th percentiles) returned '#NAME?'. Although the task instructions suggested using PERCENTILE.INC, the test environment's Excel engine/validator appears not to recognize this function name. 

Action: Replace `PERCENTILE.INC(range, k)` with the legacy `PERCENTILE(range, k)` function in the next iteration to ensure compatibility with the evaluation environment.
